main_text.l: [Woodcut emblem: a circle with the inscription "PROTECTOR MEVS : DE VENTRE MATRIS MEAE TV ES" around the rim, and four quadrants reading "S. / S.", "P. / P.", "SIX / PP." and "TVS / V.".]
† Ego M. S. Car. ab Altaemps.
† Ego Io. Ana. Card. de Arag.

page.notes: The emblem's inscription is set around the rim; the words read "PROTECTOR MEVS : DE VENTRE MATRIS MEAE TV ES", beginning at the upper left and running clockwise, with the last words at the bottom. The quadrant letters are "S.S.", "P.P.", "SIX PP." and "TVS V." (the last two form SIXTVS PP. V. across the bottom). The woodcut is transcribed as described, not copied letter by letter. In the right column, "Regalis" is split across two lines without a printed hyphen, so it is written whole. Faint show-through of the reverse page appears at the top right and in the centre; it is left out. Several dagger marks stand alone with no text and are not transcribed. Printed spellings such as "Sanctacrucius", "Georgÿ" and "Dexa" are left as printed. "Ruff." may be "Ruf." or "Ruff." and is not certain.
